content.title: Are Jorge and Vanelle Back Together? This TMZ Video Has ‘Age of Attraction’ Fans Questioning Things
content.text: Age of Attraction TrailerCosmopolitan UKLIVECurrent Time 0:06Total Duration 1:59A new TMZ video suggests Jorge Sanchez and Vanelle Femnou may be back together after their breakup on Age of Attraction.Their current relationship status remains unclear, but the reunion will likely reveal whether they’ve reconciled.Vanelle recently went on The Viall Files to explain that off-camera controntation with a stranger that led to their breakup.So…when Jorge Sanchez and Vanelle Femnou broke up soon after leaving the Promise Room on Age of Attraction, I figured the two were done done. After all, the two have a 33-year age gap and seemingly very little in common—and between Vanelle’s celibacy, Jorge’s children, and the mysterious off-camera encounter with a “crazy guy” that eventually broke them up, the odds of them getting back together seemed slim. But then, ahead of the Age of Attraction season 1 reunion, TMZ dropped a video that made me question everything.The video in question appears to show Jorge and Vanelle “locking lips,” seemingly taken at an Age of Attraction wrap party held at The Godfrey Hollywood Hotel last Friday night. And now it possibly seems like the two are back together following their tumultuous time on the show.Further evidence: Pls enjoy these pics that Leah Woolfolk posted of Jorge and Vanelle from the night in question.This content is imported from instagram. You may be able to find the same content in another format, or you may be able to find more information, at their web site.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowAlso, this:InstagramDuring an appearance last month on The Viall Files, Vanelle went into more detail about the off-camera incident that led to her breaking up with Jorge. According to her, the two were approached by a “crazy guy who appeared to be homeless or on drugs,” and when the man began screaming at them, Jorge didn’t exactly de-escalate the situation.As she explained, “I understood Jorge was trying to defend me as best as he could, but he didn’t need to do all those alpha posturing towards someone who never even attacked me in the first place. I was angry because Jorge was doing a screaming match with a stranger.”This content is imported from youTube. In my mind, I’m like, you’re very grown…I was trying to explain to him there was a way that you could have diffused the situation…and I think it triggered Jorge, because it came off as if I was trying to tell him like how to behave or what to do as a man.”It definitely seems like the two have kissed since the incident…but have they made up? Guess we’ll find out when the reunion drops at 7 p.m. ET on The Viall Files YouTube channel!
